content: Velos offers 2 distinct product families: (1) Web Offers — 4 website tiers (Starter €500, Business €1,500, Premium €2,500, Enterprise on quote) — no fixed timeline, duration depends on project. (2) AI & Automation Packs — 3 packs (Connect €1,500 / 7–10d dev, Commerce €3,500 / 14d dev, System €7,000 / 21d dev). Timelines are development days counted from Phase 3.

Velos is a digital agency specialized for African markets. Main promise: your business online in days, not months. Flash delivery available in 48h. 3x faster than the competition. Zero hidden costs. Custom code only, no bloated templates. Contact: contact@velos.agency. Book a 30-minute slot via Calendly.

Velos web services — 4 project types: 1) Brand & Showcase: institutional website focused on brand image and qualified lead generation. 2) Sales & E-Commerce: high-performance transactional platform, optimized conversion and advanced catalog management. 3) SaaS & Web App: complex business application, user management, dashboards and data processing. 4) Other / Custom: specific needs, custom architecture, or heavy/experimental API integration.

Velos web pricing — 4 tiers with NO fixed delivery timeline (duration depends on project scope): Starter at €500 (+ monthly maintenance) includes Core Architecture, Basic Design System, Standard Deployment. Business at €1,500 one-time includes Starter + Core SEO, Advanced CMS Integration, Built-in Analytics. Premium at €2,500 one-time includes Business + Complex Animations (WebGL), High-Performance E-commerce, 24/7 Priority Support. Enterprise on quote with Custom Architecture for Custom Development, Data Migration, Hardened Security. NOTE: the 7–10d, 14d, 21d timelines do NOT apply to web tiers — they apply exclusively to the AI & Automation packs.

Velos AI & Automation packs — 3 packs: Connect at €1,500 (7–10 development days) includes 1 automation workflow, 1 integration between 2 tools, 3-month n8n hosting, documentation + 1h training. Commerce at €3,500 (14 development days) includes AI bot (WhatsApp or web), automatic lead qualification, real-time team notifications, CRM sync, 6-month hosting. System at €7,000 (21 development days) includes 3 integrated workflows, multichannel AI bot (WhatsApp + email + web), pilot dashboard, custom 3-tool integration, 12-month hosting + monitoring. These timelines (7-10d, 14d, 21d) are pure development days. The count only starts after the Phase 3 scoping, once all workflows are validated and all accesses provided — the scoping time itself, of variable duration, is not included.

Velos retainer plans — 2 options: Velos Keep at €50/mo (3-month commitment, web clients) includes hosting, technical updates, weekly backups, email support 48h. Velos Care at €250/mo (6-month commitment, reserved for AI packs — others on quote) includes 24/7 workflow monitoring, minor adjustments ≤2h/mo, monthly performance report, monthly strategic review, priority support <4 business hours.

Velos process — 5 steps with 30/40/30% staggered payment: Step 1 Discovery — project simulator then analysis meeting. Step 2 Order — contract signed, 30% deposit, kick-off: we define the exact scope and timeline. Step 3 Scoping & Preparation — we lay the foundations: mockup validation (web) or workflow design and validation + handover of required accesses CRM/API/WhatsApp Business (AI), 40% payment. This phase's duration depends on the project and the client's responsiveness — it is NOT counted in the announced timelines. Step 4 Development & Delivery — this is where, and only where, the development day count begins (7-10d, 14d, 21d depending on the pack), pure dev once scoping is locked; full demo, 30% final payment, go-live. Step 5 Recurring — maintenance from €50/mo, SEO/Ads/AI content for Growth clients.
Velos guarantee: you receive exactly what was validated, on schedule. Penalty applied if we are late. No hidden costs. Full transparency throughout the project.

Velos architectural extensions — 3 modules: Mobile Money Integrations (leading African financial operators, instant transactions, bank-grade security). WhatsApp Automation (AI conversational bots, transactional notifications, smart routing, Cloud API). CRM Synchronization (real-time bidirectional sync between storefront, back-office and sales tools, zero double entry).

Velos automation services — 3 domains: Automations & Workflows (eliminate repetitive tasks — automated quotes, follow-ups, reporting, lead qualification). AI Conversational Bots (WhatsApp, web and email agents 24/7, qualify prospects, notify team in real time). Integrations & Pipelines (CRM, ERP, marketing automation, accounting — bidirectional sync, zero double entry).

Velos contact: email contact@velos.agency, book a 30-min slot via Calendly. After booking, Velos analyzes your project and sends a detailed proposal within 24h. Instagram: @velos.agency. LinkedIn: Velos Agency.
